اجتمروا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَمَرُوا (ijtamarū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# اِجْتَمِرُوا (ijtamirū) /id͡ʒ.ta.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
